results.title: SK hynix Developing New NAND Products for KV Cache ...
results.content:
KV cache is temporary data required for graphics processing units (GPUs) to handle AI computations. As AI data surges, the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity for storing KV cache is reaching its limits. In response, SK hynix plans to develop new products that mount high-capacity NAND products near the GPU, allowing them to serve as an additional KV cache repository. [...] SK hynix (000660.KS) said on the 29th during its second-quarter earnings conference call that it is developing new NAND product families such as "near-GPU storage" driven by key-value (KV) cache offloading. "We are proceeding with NAND development in a direction that most efficiently delivers the performance customers require," the company said. [...] "As the AI market expands from training to inference-centric operations, the role of NAND is rapidly changing into a key element in configuring the AI memory hierarchy," SK hynix said. "We will expand our NAND product families to secure new growth drivers."

Combining hard drives with SSDs extends Key-Value (KV) cache stores beyond the limits of memory. [...] The KV cache grows with each additional user and prompt in the context window. But because the KV cache usually lives in the GPU’s HBM or the CPU’s DRAM, most deployments are running out of capacity to retain these contexts over the life of the user’s session or dialog.

## Challenges [...] As inference scales up, in both the number of users and context length, the KV cache can become a bottleneck. The KV cache is the memory store for key and value vectors from previously computed tokens. It allows a model to support long, multi-turn exchanges in a single session without recalculating previous prompts (Figure 1). results.title: ITME: Inference Tiered Memory Expansion with ...
results.content: ITME implements differentiated fallback policies for cache misses. While a model weight miss inevitably triggers a pipeline stall, a KV cache miss is resolved through dynamic recomputation on the GPU. This design choice avoids the inefficiency of retrieving isolated missing blocks from the remote tier, which would necessitate either suboptimal chunk-sized transfers or complex retrieval logic. Consequently, recomputing the missing KV segments directly on the GPU is more performance-efficient [...] mitigates memory capacity and I/O bottlenecks through software prefetching and read-priority scheduling. Overall, ITME enhances conventional CPU-offloading by providing the necessary memory expansion to accommodate large KV cache footprints beyond host memory limits, achieving up to a 35.7% throughput improvement. results.title: Samsung และ SK Hynix ทรุดตัวลงอย่างหนัก หลัง Google ‘TurboQuant’ สร้างความปั่นป่วนในกลุ่มเซมิคอนดักเตอร์: หรือจะเป็นเพียง ‘สัญญาณหลอก’?
results.content: ในมุมมองทางเทคนิค เทคโนโลยีนี้สามารถใช้ได้กับการใช้ VRAM แบบไดนามิกระหว่างกระบวนการประมวลผล (Inference) เท่านั้น (โดยหลักคือ KV Cache) และไม่เกี่ยวข้องกับน้ำหนักของโมเดล (Model Weights) แต่อย่างใด กล่าวอีกนัยหนึ่งคือ ความสำเร็จที่ยิ่งใหญ่ที่สุดของเทคโนโลยีนี้คือการปรับปรุงประสิทธิภาพการดำเนินงาน แต่ไม่สามารถลดพื้นที่จัดเก็บข้อมูลที่โมเดลขนาดใหญ่ต้องการได้
